title: Illinois officials investigate apparent cyberattack on Algonquin Dam
date_note: Gizmodo (published 21 Nov) says the operator detected the Nov. 16 incident; the disclosure was reported around 20 to 21 Nov.
geo_basis: Algonquin Dam on the Fox River, Illinois, as named by Gizmodo; town centre
summary: CBS Chicago reports the Illinois Department of Natural Resources (IDNR) described an apparent cyberattack at Algonquin Dam on the Fox River on Monday, with no indication of a link to nationwide outages. State police, IEMA, Illinois DoIT and CISA were investigating, CBS says. Gizmodo, citing the Tribune and ABC 7, dates it 16 Nov and quotes IDNR saying it took immediate action to keep the dam secure and fully operational.
plain: Illinois officials say Algonquin Dam was subject to an apparent cyberattack, which state agencies and CISA are investigating, CBS Chicago reports. IDNR says it acted to keep the dam secure and fully operational.
exec: A US dam operator reports a cyberattack; IDNR says the dam stayed secure and fully operational.
action: No action needed; for awareness. Operators of dams and water systems can watch for IDNR and CISA updates.
impact: IDNR says it took immediate action to keep the dam secure and fully operational.

sources.name: CBS Chicago: Illinois officials investigating 'apparent cyberattack' at Algonquin Dam on Fox River
BNO News: Illinois investigates apparent cyberattack on Fox River dam

validation.note: Gizmodo and CBS Chicago (cbsnews.com) each state the IDNR's statement of an apparent cyberattack at the dam; BNO News relays CBS. Follow-up re-read CBS Chicago (updated 20 Nov 10:39 PM CST): investigating agencies (Illinois State Police, IEMA, Illinois DoIT, CISA) and IDNR's no-link-to-outages statement; no attribution, no later update found. The IDNR release itself was not read; searches found no newer reporting.

review.note: stronger than the source / source not read: removed an IDNR quote ('was subject to a cyberattack earlier this week') I could not find in Gizmodo or CBS; summary now attributes apparent cyberattack and no-link statement to CBS, 16 Nov and quoted keep-secure line to Gizmodo; trimmed to under 75 words.
